description: Cycling Infrastructure Database is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. London’s Cycling Infrastructure Database (CID) is the world’s largest and most complete database of cycling infrastructure, containing details of cycling infrastructure in the Capital. The CID is intended to address barriers to cycling by providing Londoners with clear and accurate information about cycling infrastructure, helping them plan cycle journeys with confidence. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
